reasoning: This is a standalone Go binary (cmd/llm-d-routing-sidecar/main.go) built into a container image (Dockerfile, ubi-micro base, ENTRYPOINT /app/llm-d-routing-sidecar). It runs as a long-lived HTTP/HTTPS reverse proxy sidecar next to vLLM decode pods. It listens on port 8000, forwards to vLLM on 8001, and sends prefill requests to the host named in the x-prefiller-host-port header, using the NIXL, NIXLv2, or LMCache P/D connectors. It defines no CRDs and runs no reconcile loop, so it is not an operator. Its optional SSRF protection only watches InferencePool resources and pods to build an allowlist. It ships as a runnable binary, not as importable packages (code lives under internal/), so it is not a library. The deploy/ kustomize manifests are just there to deploy it. Note: the README says this repo is deprecated and the code has moved to llm-d-inference-scheduler (cmd/pd_sidecar, pkg/sidecar).
